live.rtao_pass_built.source: rtao_setting::PassBuilt(): the renderer built the ray traced occlusion pass

live.rt_field_class.source: The GPU class used by the RT city and bounce light gates, low until class detection has completed

live.renderer_forced.source: Whether the environment or command line set gpu.driver

live.renderer_choice.source: The live or deferred gpu.driver mapped through PickOfDriver

live.fsr1_preset_custom.source: Whether the current FSR 1 preset parses as custom

live.frame_generation_choice_available.source: Whether the saved frame generation choice is available or can still be running

live.frame_generation_applying.source: Whether the saved frame generation choice is waiting for a live switch

live.fsr_frame_generation_listed.source: FSR frame generation was probed and is available or failed

live.frame_generation_multiplier_listed.source: DLSS frame generation is listed and offers a multiplier choice

live.frame_generation_multiplier.source: The effective DLSS frame generation multiplier

live.frame_generation_half_display.source: The current frame generation cap derived from the display refresh rate

live.fsr_frame_generation_state.source: FSR frame generation failure or video memory pressure

live.dlss_frame_generation_state.source: The result of the DLSS frame generation runtime probe
